structure: One shared library product fact must reach public-export root selection, ABI admission, wrappers, shared linker and interface publication. Reuse existing semantic library-interface metadata and SHA256 implementation rather than introduce a second signature contract.
branches: Public user declarations outside stdlib/local/native declarations; zero exports; fixed-width signature shapes; effects; generic/type failures; deterministic ordinal name order, collisions; Windows/Linux shared link, browser reject.
logic: CSharp Create computes the complete bound ABI hash before declaration validation. ABI material uses qualifiedName NUL parameterType names NUL-arrow result, newline between ordered exports. Symbol uses slg_ plus full lowercase hash plus sanitized function name. Signature hash additionally covers member name, symbol and parameter name:type. Shared program roots exclude main. Link flags select DLL/noentry or PIC/shared.
diagnostics: Actual CSharp no-public/Int/effects messages confirmed. Generic parameter fails while building ABI material before the later declaration-specific diagnostic; preserve this observed priority. No diagnostic oracle changes or shared-library fallback to executable.
publication: Build/validate metadata before code generation; write LLVM/binary stages and link; only successful product publication writes the target-specific slglib JSON atomically. Preserve failure stages under existing lifecycle rules.
